matches.rationale: GT1 concerns a contradiction about which gating position (G1 vs G3) is most effective. Neither finding addresses this contradiction; pred_id 1 discusses multi-head attention projection issues, and pred_id 2 discusses figure-text inconsistencies about position labels but not about which position performs best.

GT2 concerns the gating formula in Equation 5 being changed from multiplicative (Y ⊙ σ(XW_θ)) to additive (Y + σ(XW_θ)). Neither finding addresses this specific formula defect; pred_id 1 discusses projection matrices in Equations 1 and 3, and pred_id 2 discusses figure-text position label inconsistencies.
